worldcombat.skill.telekinesis.summary: Actually lift one eligible body into low air. Hostile targets keep native resistance and control permissions, and an explicitly chosen ally can also be lifted. Ceilings limit height; damage, removal or separation releases it. Ground-type immunity requires real clearance.
worldcombat.skill.telekinesis.use.0: Hang a fleeing opponent in mid-air and focus it
worldcombat.skill.telekinesis.use.1: Lift a target out of reach of Ground moves (also protects it from them)
worldcombat.skill.telekinesis.use.2: Focus fire while the target can barely move
worldcombat.skill.telekinesis.descriptio: Lift a visible body within %1$s blocks for at most %2$s seconds, reducing movement by %3$s. Ground-type damage is prevented only while actually clear of its supporting surface.
%1$s s wind-up, %2$s s recovery, %3$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.telekinesis.pin.on: Pin: 95% suppression, nearly rooted, but duration x0.7, cooldown x1.25 and wind-up +3.
worldcombat.skill.telekinesis.pin.off: Hang: duration x1.15 and cooldown x0.9, cheaper to cast and held longer, but the target can still crawl a step.
worldcombat.skill.telekinesis.timing: Cast on one opponent; after a %2$s s wind-up it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s s recovery, %5$s s cooldown from commit, current range %1$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.telekinesis.growth.0: At level %1$s the reach grows to %2$s blocks and the lift lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.telekinesis.growth.1: At level %1$s the reach grows to %2$s blocks and the lift lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.telekinesis.preference: On = pin: 95% suppression, nearly rooted, but duration x0.7, cooldown x1.25 and wind-up +3. Off = hang: duration x1.15 and cooldown x0.9, held longer but the target can still crawl. Control trades against duration.
The move is considered only when the threat is within this distance; larger means lifting from farther away, smaller means only at close range.
On: only lift targets that still stand on the ground; flying targets are skipped. Off: lift already-airborne targets too.
On: do not lift Fire/Electric/Poison/Rock/Steel-like targets, so their Ground weakness is not shielded. Off: control first, lift them anyway.
On: a holding companion will leave its post to lift the target. Off: it casts only where it already stands.
world_combat.move.telekinesis.text.settl: The hold relaxes, drifting back down
world_combat.move.telekinesis.text.cut: The hold is cut, dropping hard
worldcombat.skill.telekinesis.descriptio: An opponent that is already suspended cannot be lifted again; burrowing species such as Diglett, Dugtrio, Sandygast and Palossand refuse to leave the ground, and the cast also needs an unobstructed line to the target.
When the time runs out the hold releases and the suppressed movement returns; being smacked down or caught by Gravity cuts it short early.
Rooting, grounding and native refusal prevent the lift. Actual damage, removal, caster loss or leaving the lift point releases it. Ceilings determine real height.
